description: Check GROMACS geometry, topology, sequence, chemistry, environment and run parameters. Optional CPU grompp/energy/minimization/stability probes. Produces a verdict, JSON findings and HTML report; never changes inputs. A completed check may report fail or warn. No finding is proof of scientific validity.

coords.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

fasta.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

input.description: Uploaded tar/tar.gz/zip bundle or standalone GROMACS TPR; not a local path.

intent.description: Scientific intent, e.g. dt=0.002, hmr=no, length_ns=100, stage=production.

mdp.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

ndx.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

nsteps.description: Steps for optional short probes, not the production simulation length.

probes.description: Optional CPU GROMACS probes; default static checks only. Source files required.

top.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

tpr.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

workflow.description: Relative file path inside the uploaded bundle; never an absolute or external path.

output_prefix.description: Directory in your assigned bucket for automatic result.json, artifacts and manifest.json delivery. Defaults to runs/<model-id>; the operation ID is appended. Never sent to the model.
